title: The Route of the Exodus
note: GENUINELY DISPUTED. The route of the Exodus is not established fact — even the location of Mount Sinai is uncertain (Jebel Musa is the traditional site; others are proposed). This is one traditional reconstruction of the southern route, drawn to show the shape of the journey, not to settle it.

points.note: The starting point in the Nile delta (Exodus 12:37).
The first stage out of Egypt — location uncertain.
The 'Sea of Reeds' crossing; the exact body of water is debated.
Jebel Musa is the traditional Mount Sinai — but the true site is genuinely unknown.
The oasis where Israel stayed through much of the wilderness years.
Opposite Jericho, on the edge of the promised land (Numbers 22:1).
